issue_request: FHIR-25922 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification R4 issue for R5. Although the issue summary mentioned DeviceDefinition.capability, the Jira comments and resolution narrowed the accepted change to Device.definition becoming CodeableReference(DeviceDefinition) so a Device could identify a DeviceDefinition by reference, code, or text.
initial_application: Git commit 7cb1548fac9c810f4943ecce7f02f7f549d87726 applied the seed by changing source/device/structuredefinition-Device.xml so Device.definition used CodeableReference with targetProfile DeviceDefinition. The current source no longer has DeviceDefinition.capability, consistent with later DeviceDefinition capability/specialization cleanup.
additional_context: FHIR-40397 was Applied for R6 and explicitly changed Device.definition back from CodeableReference(DeviceDefinition) to Reference(DeviceDefinition), moving code semantics to Device.type and DeviceDefinition.classification.type. FHIR-46560 was Resolved - No Change because R6 InfoBallot #3 removed CodeableReference(DeviceDefinition) from Device and directed use of Device.type instead. FHIR-39389 and related OO discussion then moved DeviceDefinition toward canonical resource modeling; the current source uses canonical(DeviceDefinition), and FHIR-53625's Applied R6 ballot note documents that datatype.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing CodeableReference would conflict with later Applied/No-Change R6 decisions and with the current active Device source rather than fixing a missed FHIR-25922 application.
